states.notes: A request is made by providing written notice to the other party (AS 14.30.193); the filer must also provide DEED a copy. DEED's model form directs the signed, dated request to Special Education Dispute Resolution by mail, fax, or email. Form is optional. The educ.state.ak.us/sped page is live and shows the same PO Box, fax, and email. Email filing: sped@alaska.gov. Fax: (907) 465-2806. The notice's filing section repeats: "To file a due process hearing request, parents must do so in within 12 months from the date the school district provided a written notice..." (sic). Districts must file within 60 days (4 AAC 52.550). Both tolling exceptions (misrepresentation; withheld information) restated. The safeguards PDF carries no visible revision date; a call to (907) 465-8693 could confirm it is the current edition.

That is stronger than the federal both-parties rule and it is ordered — serve the district first, then file with proof enclosed. ADDRESS LINE ORDER was corrected to match the source, which prints Special Education Division above Office of Administrative Hearings. A parent who cannot use any route is told to call OAH at (916) 263-0880. CHECK BEFORE STAMPING: confirm the line order and that SFT still requires the SE-CESA.
